title: Concept: Test environment forwards secrets
description: tox.ini declares a `passenv` entry that hands credentials to the test process, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A secret committed in this file is readable by everyone with repository access and lives on in history after removal. This rule reads a `passenv` entry that hands credentials to the test process.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through tox.ini (pypi).
risk: A secret committed in this file is readable by everyone with repository access and lives on in history after removal. This rule reads a `passenv` entry that hands credentials to the test process.
